description: All 645 closed paper trades have action='short' and side='short'. Zero LONG trades have ever been executed. The PPO model's action_probabilities have index[2] (SHORT) near 1.0 for virtually all symbols/timeframes. The LONG action path (index[1]) is structurally suppressed at training time.

action_index_mapping.note: Inferred from probability distributions — index[2] is always highest

sample_predictions.interpretation: short prob 29.6% — lowest confidence short observed

strategy_router_trace.long_path_code: line 481: if higher_direction == action and mid_direction in {None, action}: selected_mode = MODE_TREND (applies equally to long and short)
strategy_router_trace.long_block_finding: Strategy router does NOT block LONG — the issue is upstream: PPO never outputs 'long' with sufficient confidence
strategy_router_trace.position_transition_check: line 208-217: _position_transition_allowed() — FLAT allows both long and short

root_cause.explanation: The PPO model was trained in an environment where SHORT trades dominated the reward signal. The trainer likely processed bearish market data or had a reward function that over-rewarded short positions. Result: model converged to always outputting action=short. The LONG action path (action_probabilities[1]) is effectively dead weight.
root_cause.evidence: 5 sampled prediction keys all show action_probabilities[1] (LONG) < 0.01% probability
root_cause.implication: The system has zero exposure to LONG-side momentum, trend-following, or mean-reversion opportunities. In a bull market, all SHORT trades are structurally losers. The observed 30.39% win rate includes BOTH bull and bear periods — in a sustained uptrend the WR would collapse further.

tests_required: test: inject a prediction with action='long', verify paper loop accepts it and creates LONG position
test: verify strategy_router routes long action to trend_mode when higher_direction='long'
test: verify PPO model checkpoint can output action[1] (long) when trained on bullish data
test: verify position_transition_allowed(FLAT, long) returns True
